data.name: Moeru Chi’s note for you
data.description: “Ah, the fool comes to challenge death itself. The Lich has felt your footsteps long before you knew where to tread. And I, Moeru Chi, watch with glee. data.name: My Deepest Regards
data.description:
The monk receives Miyuna with a quiet, respectful nod. "She is safe now, in the care of our shrine," he says softly, though his gaze betrays a depth of thought he keeps hidden.

"You have done well, traveler. For now, rest knowing she is protected."

Yet, as you leave, the weight of unanswered questions presses on your mind. While Miyuna may be safe with the monks, the reasons for her appearance and the secrets of the Bamboo Grove feel further from your grasp. Her mystery remains, and with it, the sense that there is much more to uncover.

data.name: Night's Testament
data.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.  In Seichi, it is said that:  the blade grows heavier with lies,  lighter with resolve,  and will not draw blood unless the wielder’s intent is absolute.  Those who survive its cut remember nothing. Those who fall become part of it.
data.battleDescription: %user holds a blade as dark as night. With one swift movement, too quick for the naked eye, the blade pierces through %target.

data.name: Okuri Okami Pelt
data.description: At first glance, this pelt looks important. Regal, even. The fur is impossibly soft, with a silvery sheen that suggests divine blessings, ancient spirits, and maybe a very cool backstory.  It has none of those.
data.battleDescription: You dramatically brandish the Okami Pelt as combat begins, letting it billow heroically in the wind.  For a brief, shining moment, everyone on the battlefield—including your enemies—pauses just long enough to wonder if something important is about to happen.  Nothing happens.

data.name: Old Scroll from the Black Stone
data.description:
The scroll lay sealed within a black stone. How it came to rest there, one
can only wonder. Upon the scroll, these words are inscribed:

Upon the land of Fujin you stand, beneath his watchful eye,
But to the place you seek, three barriers lie
Waters of silver, three seas of blue,
Cross them with courage, the path will be true.
What is this place, where journey and quest,
Are separated only by three waters, no more, no less?

data.name: Old Scroll from the Lake
data.description: The scroll was found resting at the bottom of the lake, but alas, the waters have seeped into the scroll case. Now, its once-clear inscriptions have become blurred, making the ancient writings difficult to decipher. The only discernible mark upon the scroll is a faint depiction of a tiny sand oasis, encircled by lush forests and verdant fields. A most curious and perplexing image indeed. Is there, perhaps, such a place upon this globe?

data.name: Old Scroll from the Sand Golem
data.description: Upon the fall of the golem, a scroll emerged from its crumbling form, pristine and untouched by time. The scroll reveals how Satsume crafted and left golems to guard the sacred scrolls. It also discloses the location of the next Golem guardian—an abundant, verdant land, nestled between the Northern Desert and the frozen Arctic, where sand and ice nearly converge.
